summary: The promise and the bill on your desk: {the bill} on your desk breaks a promise you made in public, and its backers have the votes.
realLife: One life: He said a right-to-work law would not reach his desk, repeated it in 2014, then signed one in 2015. Another: He promised police and firefighters no pension changes, then signed changes in 2010, and their unions sued. Another: He left the House in 2000 to keep his promise to serve only three terms, then ran for governor.
gates: {the promise} is on record, and {the bill} would break it.
weights: How much your backers want the bill.
